falsification_conditions.condition: Bitcoin closes above $72,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires price to remain below prior resistance and continue consolidating or declining. This would signal a new uptrend, not a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on perpetual swaps exceeds 0.05% for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained positive funding indicates leveraged longs are piling in aggressively. A bottoming pattern requires fear and deleveraging, not euphoric leverage. This would suggest the market has already bottomed and is now overheating, contradicting the HOLD signal.

falsification_conditions.condition: Bitcoin dominance drops below 50% while total crypto market cap rises above $2.6 trillion
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rotation into altcoins with rising total market cap would indicate risk appetite is returning broadly. The bottom_2024_aug pattern expects continued BTC dominance and capital flight to safety. This rotation would signal the bottom is already in and a new risk-on cycle has begun.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
